configurePresets.name: minimal
configurePresets.displayName: Minimal (= a plain configure): CUDA on, docs off, notebook off
configurePresets.description: The defaults of a plain `cmake -S . -B <dir>`: RelWithDebInfo, the CUDA layer at OC_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=120, no TeX and no notebook (neither required nor probed).

configurePresets.name: cpu-only
configurePresets.description: OC_ENABLE_CUDA=OFF: nvcc / libcudart are never searched; EngineCuda is the CPU stub, ENGINE_DEVICE=cpu (the golden path) is the only device path, the device validations print [SKIP].

configurePresets.name: reference
configurePresets.displayName: Reference machine (GCC 11.4, nvcc 13.0, RTX 5070 Ti sm_120): everything on
configurePresets.description: The reference machine's configuration: CUDA sm_120, the LaTeX docs targets (`make docs`) and the notebook hooks.

configurePresets.name: jetson-orin
configurePresets.description: NVIDIA Jetson Orin (aarch64): CUDA at compute capability 8.7, docs and notebook off.

configurePresets.name: termux
configurePresets.displayName: Small device (Termux / phone / any CPU-only host): -O2, no -g, stripped, section-gc
configurePresets.description: CPU-only, Release at -O2 (the code shape of record), no debug info, OC_SMALL_BINARY=ON (gc-sections, ICF where the linker has it) and OC_STRIP_BINARY=ON (-s). About 45 MB instead of ~800 MB for the default RelWithDebInfo. `make install/strip` gives the same.

configurePresets.name: aarch64-cpu
configurePresets.description: The termux preset for an aarch64 Linux host (the CMakeLists adds -ffp-contract=off on aarch64).

configurePresets.name: jetson-orin-cpu
configurePresets.description: NVIDIA Jetson Orin (aarch64), CPU-only: no CUDA toolkit used.
